name: Auberdine Coast
summary: The Auberdine Coast stretches along the western shoreline of Darkshore, bordering the night elven port town of Auberdine. Its docks serve as the primary maritime lifeline connecting northern Kalimdor to Teldrassil and the Eastern Kingdoms. Travellers and fishermen walk its sands beneath misty, shadowed skies.

sections.title: A Lifeline on the Veiled Sea
sections.body: Running along the edge of Darkshore, the Auberdine Coast hosts the sprawling timber piers of Auberdine. Through these docks, night elven vessels transport supplies and pilgrims between Rut'theran Village at the foot of Teldrassil and mainland Kalimdor, alongside Alliance ships sailing west from Menethil Harbor. Away from the bustle of the harbor, the cold waters wash ashore driftage, beached sea creatures, and wreckage brought in by the treacherous tides of the Veiled Sea.

sections.title: Washed Ashore
sections.body: The shoreline is rarely peaceful. Beached thresher carcasses and giant sea turtles attract scavengers, while murlocs and naga prowl the shoals. Local night elves regularly scout the sandbars to investigate strange strandings, salvage nautical supplies, and keep the trade lane secure from sea monsters lurking just beneath the surf.

faq.answer: It is the seaside strip of Darkshore surrounding the night elf settlement of Auberdine. Its most prominent features are the long wooden docks handling ferry traffic to Teldrassil and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Where do the ships at the coast lead?
faq.answer: The ships departing from the Auberdine piers connect travelers north to Rut'theran Village at the roots of Teldrassil, and east across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why are there beached sea creatures along the shore?
faq.answer: The waters off Darkshore have grown increasingly disturbed, casting dead threshers, turtles, and other deep-sea beasts onto the beaches. Night elf scholars and hunters frequently investigate the strandings to understand what is afflicting the sea life.
Aside from aggressive crab and crawler species, the shoreline frequently sees incursions by Greymist murlocs and prowling naga, as well as hostile water elementals and reef predators.

angles.text: The coast houses the primary Alliance naval foothold in northern Kalimdor, making it an essential hub for travelers crossing the sea from Wetlands or Teldrassil.
For the night elves, this shoreline is a crucial gateway linking their sacred home on Teldrassil with the ancestral lands of mainland Kalimdor.
